FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 310
Committee: Finance and Taxation Education Sponsor: Senator Arthur Orr
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 05/16/2023
Senate Bill 310 as introduced would require the cost of any increase in benefit amounts to
retirees under the Teachers' Retirement System (TRS) and the Employees' Retirement System
(ERS) in order to be funded, to be included in the appropriation acts for that year, along with the
employer rate established to fund the actual cost of the increase. This would increase the
administrative obligations of the actuary for the Retirement Systems of Alabama to calculate the
actual cost to fund an increase in benefits for retirees of the TRS and the ERS and to provide an
annual estimate to each authorized local unit participating in the ERS granting an increase in
benefits. This bill will not otherwise directly affect state or local funding.
